passages.provision_quote: Subject to subdivision (b), an owner of residential real property shall not, over the course of any 12-month period, increase the gross rental rate for a dwelling or a unit more than 5 percent plus the percentage change in the cost of living, or 10 percent, whichever is lower, of the lowest gross rental rate charged for that dwelling or unit at any time during the 12 months prior to the effective date of the increase.
passages.note: AB 1482 caps annual rent increases statewide at 5% plus CPI or 10% and adds just-cause eviction protection, extending coverage to units with no prior cap while exempting new construction and certain small properties.
Assembly Floor concurrence-in-Senate-amendments vote on AB 1482; Wicks is listed among the Ayes on final passage.
passages.tally_quote: Ayes Count 48 Noes Count 26 NVR Count 5

rows.reasoning: AB 1482 (2019-2020), the Tenant Protection Act of 2019, caps annual rent increases statewide at 5 percent plus the change in the cost of living or 10 percent, whichever is lower, and adds just-cause eviction protection, extending coverage to units with no prior rent regulation while exempting new construction and certain small properties — matching the rung text 'Strengthen existing rent stabilization and extend coverage to more units' rather than 'cover all rental units communitywide,' which the bill's own exemptions exclude. Wicks is recorded among the Ayes on the Assembly Floor concurrence vote passing the bill.
